resources.title: Quickstart
resources.why: Start here: a working API with a serializer, a viewset and a router in a few minutes, the same three pieces as this exercise.

resources.title: Tutorial 6: ViewSets & Routers
resources.why: Explains how a viewset replaces separate list and detail views and how the router writes the URLs for you.

resources.title: Serializers: ModelSerializer
resources.why: Reference for ModelSerializer and its Meta fields option, which builds serializer fields from your model.

resources.title: ViewSets: ModelViewSet
resources.why: Lists the actions ModelViewSet gives you (list, create, retrieve, update, partial_update, destroy).

resources.title: Routers: DefaultRouter
resources.why: Shows the exact URL patterns DefaultRouter generates, useful when a test hits a URL you did not expect.
